findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box-ordinal-group
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss the order() mixin sets -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group to the same value as order. The legacy 2009 box spec is 1-indexed while modern order is 0-indexed, so the correct mapping is ordinal-group = order + 1. As written, order(2)/order(3) used for .extra-info-wrapper and .d-header .panel produce ordinal-group 2/3 instead of 3/4, mis-ordering header items in old WebKit/Firefox and breaking any future use of order(0)/order(1) which will collide with the default group.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss align-items() emits -ms-align-items, which does not exist. IE10/11 only understand -ms-flex-align. The invalid declaration is ignored, so IE gets only -ms-flex-align, and anyone relying on the second line for baseline/center alignment in IE is misled. Remove the -ms-align-items line.

findings.title: float:right on flex item is ignored, button no longer right-aligned
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss .small-action was changed to display:flex via flexbox(), but its button rule still uses float:right to push it to the far right. Per the flexbox spec float and clear have no effect on flex items, so the button becomes a normal row flex item placed directly after .small-action-desc instead of at the right edge. This is a visual regression versus the old block layout. Use margin-left:auto or justify-content instead of float for the flex case.
